title: AI 能给答案，孩子如何学
titleEn: If AI has the answers, how can our kids learn?
summary: AI 可支持学习，但无法替代人类指导。关键是教孩子何时使用 AI、何时质疑，何时独立思考。
summaryEn: AI can support learning but cannot replace human guidance. The key is teaching children when to use AI, when to question it, and when to think independently.
speaker: Liew Wei Li
